A '''planet''' existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During an intergalactic event known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which had begun by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the planet had aligned itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a major player in the war. It was eventually subjugated to an invasion from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Confederate adversary, that saw the world covered in continual fighting. The on-going war eventually prompted a civilian named [[Rayt (civilian)|Rayt]] to disguise himself a a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and try to escape the planet. Eventually he boarded a Republic vessel and was carted offworld. The planet's terrain consisted of heavy pine forests in some areas, most notably in the area surrounding Rayt's [[City/Legends|town]].<ref name="This Precious Shining" />
